svg.title: hermes home3d demo (condensed terminal output)
svg.desc: A condensed, real run of hermes home3d demo on the simulated printer: a family member's start is blocked, the watcher passes the request to the owner, the owner approves with /home3d approve, the watcher reports the finish and the auto-eject, a filament pause, a missed push and an upgrade proposal.
svg.text: hermes home3d demo · simulated printer · real output, condensed
$ hermes home3d demo
home-3d-workshop demo · persona Mıstık · language en · simulated printer · nothing is sent
── 2. Mum sends a voice note ──
🎙️ Mum (voice note, transcribed by the gateway) [staged]: Mıstık, can you print me a little gift
box for flowers?
── 7. Mum says "print it": her chat may not start a print (her ask becomes a request to the ow… ──
💬 Mum [staged]: Lovely, print it please!
⛔ home3d_start blocked by pre_tool_call (real gate):
BLOCKED: owner approval needed: Mum is not the owner. Sam sends `/home3d approve start 1`
(runs it right away, nothing is stored). Sam gets this request on the next watcher pass
(about 2 min); tell Mum you passed it on. Do not promise a start.
🤖 Mıstık → Mum [staged]:
It's in the queue (#1). I've passed it on to Sam: Sam decides when it starts.
── 8. The next watcher pass tells the owner, with the exact command ──
Mıstık → Sam (owner chat):
▶️ The camera thinks the plate is empty (diff 1.8%). Next workshop job ready: "Flower gift
box" (#1) · for Mum
🙋 Mum asked to start it.
Check the photo, then start it: /home3d approve start 1
── 9. The owner approves with a slash command (no model call; it runs right away, nothing is s… ──
⌨️ Sam [staged]: /home3d approve start 1
▶️ Started #1 "Flower gift box" (Mum). The watcher reports the finish and the plate.
── 12. End G-code: the bed cools and the part is pushed off while the printer still says RUNNI… ──
⏩ +5 min → FINISH · "Flower gift box" · bed 26°C
📣 watcher: finished_ejected · Flower gift box
Mıstık → family group:
✅ Mum, "flower box" is done. It dropped off by itself, you can take it from the box.
── 13. Filament run-out: the owner starts the coaster from his own chat ──
📣 watcher: paused · Coaster_116pct
⏸️ Paused: "Coaster 116pct" (#2) · 30% · layer 7/23 · for Dad
── 14. Resuming with a printer error active needs the owner to acknowledge it ──
⛔ home3d_stop blocked by pre_tool_call (real gate):
BLOCKED: Cannot resume: printer error 0700-2000-0002-0001: the owner must acknowledge it
first (/home3d approve resume ack).
⌨️ Sam [staged]: /home3d approve resume ack
▶️ Resumed "Coaster_116pct".
📣 watcher: plate_not_clear · Coaster_116pct
Mıstık → family group:
🙏 Dad, "coaster" is done but stayed on the plate. Could you take it off when you have a
moment?
── 19. Fast-forward: later that month another coaster stays on the plate (condensed) ──
📣 watcher: upgrade_proposed
💡 Upgrade proposal #1 (Mıstık): Auto-eject: tilted base + push-off preset
A person had to step in 3 times in 30 days (take a finished part off the plate).
https://makerworld.com/en/models/2335000
── 21. Outbox: what would have been sent (dry run; every message is shown above where it happe… ──
20 messages: 14 to the owner chat, 6 to the family group
blocked by the plugin's gates on the way: home3d_start ×2, home3d_stop ×1
✅ demo complete: request → find → import → slice → queue → non_owner_blocked → …
